zh-Hant.name: 彩虹泡泡砲
zh-Hant.summary: 瞄準發射，連成三顆以上同色泡泡就能消除，懸空泡泡也會落下。可離線單機闖關或挑戰四段本機電腦對手。
zh-Hant.controls: 點哪裡泡泡就飛向哪裡；右下角小泡泡可以換泡泡

zh-Hans.name: 彩虹泡泡砲
zh-Hans.summary: 瞄准发射，连成三个以上同色泡泡就能消除，悬空泡泡也会落下。可离线单机闯关或挑战四段本机电脑对手。
zh-Hans.controls: 点哪里泡泡就飞向哪里；右下角小泡泡可以换泡泡

en.name: Rainbow Bubble Blaster
en.summary: Aim and shoot: match three or more bubbles to pop them, and unsupported bubbles fall. Play solo or clear levels offline, with four difficulty levels of local computer opponents.
en.controls: Bubbles fly wherever you tap; swap bubbles with the small bubble at the bottom right
